name: aninta-therapy-center
description: Production-ready website and CMS for Aninta Natural & Energy Medicine Therapy Center

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.postinstall: cd server && npx prisma generate || true
